verdict.rationale: Persona documents a public API for programmatic use. You can pre-create inquiries, poll inquiry status, and fetch verification details. A backend-only Transactions API covers fully custom flows, and webhooks, sandbox mode, Simulate Actions for testing, and API key/IP allowlist configuration round out the integration surface. An llms.txt with agent instructions further supports AI-native use. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of using the API in practice.
